packages.title: YouTube Extended

manifest.title: YouTube Extended
manifest.appDescription: Unofficial YouTube fork with a transparent Green-button settings panel, ad controls, picture framing/zoom, native HDR preference and sleep timer. HDR and resolution depend on the video and TV.

packages.shortDescription: Glass settings with audio/TV shortcuts, ad controls and picture zoom.

packages.title: YouTube Extended Home

manifest.title: YouTube Extended Home
manifest.appDescription: Adds a separate LG Home icon that opens your existing YouTube Extended player. Install the player first. No video engine or settings are replaced.

packages.shortDescription: LG Home icon for the installed YouTube Extended player.
